description: .NET version upgrade plan from net6.0 to net10.0 for ContosoUniversity

tasks.description: Upgrade ContosoUniversity from net6.0 to net10.0: update TargetFramework, update all 4 NuGet packages, fix API breaking changes in Program.cs, and verify the solution builds successfully.
tasks.requirements: 1. Update TargetFramework in ContosoUniversity\ContosoUniversity.csproj from net6.0 to net10.0. 2. Update NuGet packages in ContosoUniversity\ContosoUniversity.csproj: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.EntityFrameworkCore from 6.0.2 to 10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer from 6.0.2 to 10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools from 6.0.2 to 10.0.5, Microsoft.VisualStudio.Web.CodeGeneration.Design from 6.0.2 to 10.0.2. 3. Run dotnet restore and dotnet build. 4. Fix any compilation errors caused by source-incompatible API changes in Program.cs: AddDatabaseDeveloperPageExceptionFilter (line 11) and UseMigrationsEndPoint (line 25) may need updated signatures or using directives — follow compiler errors. 5. Note behavioral change in UseExceptionHandler("/Error") at line 18 — validate error page rendering at runtime. 6. Rebuild to confirm 0 errors and 0 warnings. 7. Commit all changes as a single commit on branch upgrade-to-NET10.
